metadata.notes: Full NHS cancer screening domain: offered/declined/completed situations, FIT/FOB/sigmoidoscopy results, lung/bowel/breast/cervical programme findings, DNA events, and eligibility. Covers all four active NHS England screening programmes (bowel, breast, cervical, lung).
